answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed bird-ringing station at the vertex of three survey transects, where a licensed ringer bands wild birds at dawn and logs every ring in a public register. Random checks summon the holder to band a bird live within the hour, and one ringer cannot staff two stations at dawn. A whisper code over the station radio must be repeated live as proof a human is present. The station fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another station, another licensed ringer, and twice the prior fee.
